row: 30003185 / OWR-14745-003: Bray strong-involution sampling, original linear/unitary subquestions only; OWR37/2016 pp.2160–2161 (https://doi.org/10.4171/OWR/2016/37).

Existing publication: S. P. Glasby, Cheryl E. Praeger and Colva M. Roney-Dougal, Involution centralisers in finite unitary groups of odd characteristic, Journal of Algebra545(2020),245–299, published March1,2020. Theorem1 answers the original named unitary marginal question for every oddq, every given strongt and either separately fixed eigenspace, for sufficiently large natural dimension over F_(q^2); Theorem2 gives logarithmic independent nearly-uniform GL/GU sampling containing the SL/SU factor product. Uniform samples qualify. Determinant-surjective centralizers give identical uniform SL/SU output laws; in large dimension their second-derived target is this factor product (the elementary transfer is audited in PR1330). This is an existing full answer to these named subquestions, NOT a solution of the symplectic/orthogonal cases or a new project publication. Earlier GL marginal credited to Dixon–Praeger–Seress (10.1016/j.jalgebra.2017.11.047). Same-paper arXiv1812.01362v2 is an alias, not a separate result. Source theorem statements inspected in the pinned v2 author PDF; published metadata independently verified by Crossref and StAndrews. PR https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1330 . Natural matrix groups, sufficiently large dimensions and fixed-confidence sample count only; no total-runtime or projective claim.
